paite: Thil hoih lou hihte ziak in kihihlungkham nuam dah inla, dikloutak a hihte leng eng ke'n.
heading: David La / Kuhkal Leh Muang Ding A Hanthawnna
english: By David. Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

paite: Loupa bang in atpaih in a-om zok ding ua, louhing bang a vuai ding ahi ngal ua.
english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

paite: TOUPA muang inla, thil hoih hih in; hiai gam ah om inla, ginomna delh zel in.
english: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

paite: TOUPA tung ah leng kipak in; huchi in na lungtang deihlamte ahon pe ding hi.
english: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

paite: Na omdan ding TOUPA tung ah nga inla; amah muang in, ama'n ahih vek ding.
english: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

paite: Na dikdan vak bang in asuaksak ding a, na siamtandan leng sun lai bang mai in.
english: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

paite: TOUPA ah khawl inla, amah ngak nilouh in; a-omdan a vangphatna mute ziak in kihihlungkham nuam dah in, ngaihtuahna giloute pichin mi ziak in.
english: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

paite: Heh tawpsan inla, thangpaih kisik in; kihihlungkham nuam ke'n, thilhihkhelh ah ahong ke maimah nak hi.
english: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

paite: Thil hoih lou hihte hihmang in a-om dek ngal ua; TOUPA ngakte'n bel gam aluah ding uhi.
english: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.

paite: Sawt louchik in migilou-salou a-om nawnta kei dia; ahi, a-omna mun uh enen mah lechin, a-omta kei ding hi.
english: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

paite: Thunuailutte'n gam aluah ding ua; kituahna thupitak ah akipak ding uhi.
english: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

paite: Migilou-salou in midiktat a sawm a, aha agawikhum nak hi.
english: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

paite: Toupa'n amah anuihsan ding. Ani hong tung dek ahi chih atheih ziak in.
english: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

paite: Genthei leh tagahte hihpuk ding leh omdan dikte that ding in migilou-saloute'n namsau aphawi ua, athalpeute uh alai uhi.
english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

paite: Anamsau un amau lungtang asun ding a, thalpeute uh hihtan in a-om ding hi.
english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

paite: Midiktat thil tawmchik neih migilou-salou thil neih keihkuih sang in ahoihzaw ahi.
english: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

paite: Migilou-salou bante hihtan in a-om dek ngal a, TOUPA'N midik alen gige ding ahi.
english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.

paite: TOUPA'N mihoihkimte nite athei a; agouluah ding uh tangtawn a om gige ding ahi.
english: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

paite: Hun hoih lou ah azahlak kei ding ua; kial kum in leng avah ding uhi.
english: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

paite: Migilou-saloute amangthang ding ua, TOUPA doute leng gamlak loupa pak kilawm bang in hihmanthat in a-om ding ua, meikhu in azammang ding uhi.
english: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

paite: Migilou-salou in aleitawi a, ape nawn kei nak a; midik in bel zahngaihna suah in, ape zaw nak hi.
english: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

paite: Avualzawlna mute'n gam aluah ding ua, ahamsiatte hihmanthat in a-om ding uhi.
english: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

paite: Mi kalsuante TOUPA hihkip ahi a; alampi ah akipak nak hi.
english: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.

paite: Puk mahleh, lupdetsak in zaw a-om kei ding hi; TOUPA'N akhut in alen gige ngal a.
english: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.

paite: Naupang ka na hita a, tu in tek ka hong hita, himahleh midiktat limsak louh a a-om lam ka mu ngei kei hi, asuante an ngolh lam leng ka mu ngei sam kei hi.
english: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

paite: Mi ahehpih gige a, aleitawisak a; asuante leng ahampha nak uhi.
english: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

paite: Gilou paisan inla, thil hoih hih in; huchi in tangtawn in teng gige in.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

paite: TOUPA'N vaihawm diktat adeih ngal a, amisiangthoute apaisan ngei kei hi, tangtawn a ding in kephoih in a-om ua; migilou-salou suante bel hihmang in a-om ding uhi.
english: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

paite: Midikte'n gam aluah ding ua, asung ah tangtawn in a-om ding uh.
english: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

paite: Midik kam in pilna thu agen a, alei in vaihawm diktatna thu agen hi.
english: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

paite: A Pathian dan alungtang ah a-om a; akalsuan atolh kei ding hi.
english: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

paite: Migilou-salou in midiktat a-enkhia a, hihlup atum gige hi.
english: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

paite: TOUPA'N akhut ah anuse kei ding a, avaihawm hun chiang in siam louh tansak aphal sam kei ding hi.
english: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

paite: TOUPA ngak inla, alampi tawn in, huchi in gam luah ding in ahon pahtawi ding hi; migilou-saloute hihmanthat a a-om uh na mu ding hi.
english: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

paite: Migilou-salou nakpitak a thu nei a, apouna mun a singnou dawng thenthon bang a, ka biambuam ka mu hi.
english: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

paite: Himahleh lampi ah mi ava pai ua, ngai dih, amah ana om kei maimah a; ahi, ka zong a, himahleh muh theih ahita kei hi.
english: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

paite: Migensiatbei chiamteh inla, midiktak en in, huchibang mite tawpna ding zaw khamuanna hi ding ahi ngal a.
english: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

paite: Talekte bel akituak a hihsiat in a-om ding ua, migilou-salou tawpna ding tuh hihmanthat ahita ding hi.
english: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

paite: Himahleh midiktatte hotdamna TOUPA a kipan in ahi; amah mangbat lai a kulhpi muan ahi.
english: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

paite: TOUPA'N amaute panpih in ahumbit a, amah ah akituklut ziak un migilou-saloute lak ah humbit in ahondam hi.
english: Yahweh helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.
